rule.text: For regular first-conjugation verbs, form the imperfect active indicative from the present stem, the imperfect marker and the active personal ending.
rule.applicability: Regular first-conjugation verbs, imperfect indicative active.
caveats: Check first-person singular ending adjustments separately; this is not a rule for every Latin verb.

rule.text: In a regular first-declension noun, the genitive plural ends in -ārum.
caveats: Do not infer a noun's declension from this ending rule alone.
